title: Lightning Marriage with a Tycoon Husband
description: Professional Ginny was arranged by her grandmother to marry the man she first met, Kesten, who disappeared without a trace after the wedding. Ginny also forgot about getting married and worked hard to get into M Group. A year later, M Group President Allis Miller returned to the United States from Europe. Ginny always thought Allis looked familiar, but couldn't remember where she had seen him. At work, she chanced to discover that Miller and Kesten were the same person?

title: Flash Marriage with the Billionaire Tycoon
description: Elise was a normal accountant of Hawthorn Group. She worked very carefully to avoid any problem, but she made a huge mistake despite of her caution. She was on a business trip and was drunk, then she accidentally had an one-night stand with her boss Lucian. Her fate had changed since then...

title: ACCIDENTAL SURROGATE FOR MY CAPTAIN EX
description: Lucky and Damien were originally a very loving couple, but Lucky purposely let Damien misunderstand his own cheating in order not to drag him down, leading to their breakup. Five years later, Lucky accidentally surrogate Daimen's child, Daimen did not know that he wanted to retaliate against Lucky, but once again fell, and ultimately the two misunderstandings together again!

title: Falling In Love With My Secret Boss
description: Kim was a well - known US finance influencer. Her bluntness ticked off the Garrison Group, and she ended up in total disgrace. With no other options, she cut a deal with Damian from the group and joined the G Group. There, she met Damian, the cold and bossy younger guy, and his seemingly kind, gentle older brother.On one hand, she had this deep - seated hatred she couldn't shake. On the other, she felt this uncontrollable crush.

title: The Office Pushover Is the Real Heiress
description: Katherine Foden, a wealthy heiress, enters a company as an intern to escape an arranged marriage, only to be bullied in the workplace by a fake heiress, Kathleen who has stolen her identity and claims to be the fiancée of the CEO. Unbeknownst to her at first, the fiancée Katherine’s father has chosen for her, David McGuire, is the CEO of the company she’s interning at. Later, she gradually falls for David as David falls for her as well.

title: Days Locked With A Call Boy
description: After betrayed by her ex-boyfriend, Ellie went to a bar and mistook a billionaire-Philip Wesley for a callboy. The two were hand cuffed together by mistake, so they were forced to live together for a week,and they gradually fall in love with each other.

title: Date with a Vampire
description: When she discovered that her paranoid boyfriend was cheating on a man, she seeks revenge by dating a handsome and mysterious vampire，from then on, caught up in a love story from past and present lives.

title: Cause You Were Never Mine
description: When Jade's mother falls ill, Jade pretends to cheat with Dexter to avoid burdening Bruce, who was planning to propose. Heartbroken, Bruce breaks up with her. To revenge, Bruce starts his own business with the help of his family. Five years later, as CEO of Morgan Group, he hires Jade, thus beginning a love story of mutual torment that would touch hearts.

title: Yesterday Once More
description: Cris,a 50-year-old cool “girl” accidentally finds a perfect mate on a blind date. However, she realizes the new lover she chose has some secrets and is getting more similar to her “deceased husband”...It’s almost Christmas, has she found another true love, or is he her deceased husband?

title: I Became Mrs Grayson by Bragging
description: On the day of the interview, Alice, an ordinary girl, saved the CEO of the Grayson pharmaceutical group, and bragged that she was the CEO's financee. Unexpectedly, the CEO not only asked her to be his personal assistant, but also married her in a flash.

title: Come Back For You
description: After murdered by her ex-husband Ricky, Shannon reborn 10 years ago to start her revenge for Ricky and second chance love with Johnny Wonder.

title: Let It Be Me
description: Charlotte's parents passed away, and she was adopted by her uncle and aunt. As they grew older, her uncle arranged for Charlotte to marry Mike from the Davis family for the sake of a business partnership. In reality, Mike is a playboy and often has sexual relations with Ella. Upon discovering this, Charlotte angrily cancels her engagement with Mike and marries a homeless man named Jackson whom she found on the street.

title: Damn! The Duke Got The Wrong Girl
description: After a passionate night, Ava is stunned to learn Edmund is the new CEO, making her hissecretary. She's trapped, guarding their secret. Meanwhile, her friend Chloe manipulates Edmund into believing she's his mystery woman, securing a place in his mansion. Chloe's attempts to seduce Edmund and sabotage Ava only strengthen their bond, ultimately leading Ava to discover her true identity as a hotel heiress. With the truth exposed, Edmund and Ava find their happy ending.

title: Retrieve My Memory Loss Lover
description: Erika is the Second Daughter of one of the largest chaebol families in New York City. She witnessed her sister Emma jumping from a building. When she went to the memorial service, she found a child named Adam. Erika left home for her sister's child, but met Owen on the way. Owen claimed that the child was his. Why did Emma jump? Who are the parents of the child? Erika and Owen knew each other?

title: The Beloved of Lycan King
description: In a world where emotions run wild and secrets lurk in the shadows, Kristen, an orphaned servant, finds herself entangled in a web of love and betrayal. When fate unexpectedly leads her to Justin, the enigmatic leader, and Allen, the newly appointed Lycan King, Kristen's life takes a dramatic turn. As emotions ignite and alliances shift, Kristen must navigate the turbulent waters of romance and deception.

title: Light My Fire
description: After three years in a no-love, no-sex arranged marriage, Edith asks for a divorce when she discovers her sexy firefighter husband has gotten another woman pregnant! Even though it means burying her decade-long crush on him! However, her husband refuses to sign unless she agrees to play as a loving couple with him for one last month... Edith is shocked to find that there’s a huge misunderstanding between her and her husband.

title: My Royal Alpha Boyfriend
description: Royal Alpha Boyfriend tells the story of Bella, an ordinary girl, and Allister, a mysterious British prince, whose love story grows from an unexpected encounter. While traveling in Japan, Bella accidentally bumps into Allister, spilling coffee on him and mistaking him for a tour guide. To make amends, she insists that he guide her around.

title: Unwanted True Mate
description: A human girl, whose fated mate was stolen from her, overcomes countless obstacles to reclaim her destined mate and discover her werewolf heritage.

title: Fated to My Billionaire Call Boy
description: Claire wants to have a baby to give her ailing grandmother something to live for. When Claire’s cheating husband leaves her, she hires a call boy to make a baby with her. She doesn’t know the call boy is billionaire Dominic Bridges who is in love with her and will do anything to get her. But her scheming rival, Gina, will do anything to keep them apart.

title: Revenge of XXL Wife
description: Maddy Moss, a 250-pound housewife, transforms into a beauty after her husband Luke dumps her for his mistress Olivia. With the assistance of her childhood friend and surprise love interest Felix, a billionaire, Maddy gets revenge on Luke, Olivia and Luke’s mother.

title: Return of the Secret Heiress
description: Three years ago, Laura, heiress to the Lewis Group, the nation's wealthiest conglomerate, and a business legend, came to Maplewood to investigate an investment project. There, she fell head over heels for the unknown Ben Harrison. She hid her true identity, married Ben, and secretly helped his company become a rising star in Maplewood. After marriage, Laura worked as a cleaner at Sheppard Group and helped the group's CEO, Bryan Shepherd, resolve a business crisis.

title: Falling Into Ceo's Embrace
description: In order to reject the marriage arranged by his grandmother, Lucas claims that he would only marry if a bride falls from the sky, as it would be God's will. At once, Michelle falls from a tree while trying to save a puppy. To accept 'God's will', Lucas and Michelle hastily get married and then he goes abroad. Michelle, who haven't seen Lucas for four years, falls in love with her boss Lucas at work but hesitates to confess, because of his married status.

title: Flash Vows
description: In order to successfully adopt Sarah, Alison placed an advertisement for a contract marriage. She mistakenly thought that Robert, sitting in the corner, was her intended partner. In reality, Robert is a low-key group president who is deeply attracted to this playful and charming girl. He decides to conceal his identity and enjoy this pure encounter.

title: Why Rich Woman Kills
description: At her father's funeral, a woman discovers her husband's secret homosexual affair. Driven by revenge, she begins her perilous plan by igniting a passionate affair with a seductive man—who unexpectedly turns out to be her new assistant and the hidden heir to her rival company. What makes a rich woman turn into an angel of vengeance?

title: The Double Life Of My Hot Escort
description: After her husband cheats and her career falters, Jade escapes to LA, mistaking mob boss Domenick for her escort. When she learns she's inherited a mob group from her estranged grandfather, she asks Domenick for guidance, sparking an unexpected romance. But as enemies close in and her ex-husband resurfaces, Jade must navigate the treacherous world of crime to claim her destiny and fight for love. Can she become the ultimate mob heiress?

title: Spoiled by My Billionaire Sugar Daddy
description: In the grip of her brother's addiction and her mother's debts, a struggling young woman seeks refuge in a contractual affair with her charismatic CEO. But as their bond deepens, she realizes she's merely a stand-in for his ex-girlfriend.

title: The CEO s Contract Wife
description: Seven years ago, Emily Wilson’s world was turned upside down after a fateful night with Henry Anderson, the enigmatic CEO of Anderson Group. Now, struggling to make ends meet, Emily is back at the very hotel where it all began, driven by her career and a desperate need to save her ailing son, Jack. But fate has other plans, leading them to unwittingly sign a couple's contract.

title: Love in the Shadows
description: Sophie agrees to marry a stranger to save her family, believing he’s just a quiet, absent businessman. But her world is turned upside down when she discovers her husband is Robert Kensington, a powerful CEO with a dangerous reputation—and a family willing to betray him for control of his company. Pulled into explosive boardroom battles and shocking family secrets, Sophie finds herself in a world where love and survival are anything but guaranteed.

title: Tied to My Dangerous Mafia Husband
description: Lauren, you're pregnant with twins... Having lost her memory, Laurent returns to the country to search her father and foster brother with only a necklace as a clue. She thinks she could put up with Vivian and Jacob's harassment for the work visa, but all she got is nonstop abuse and insults. In a turn of fate, Laurent ends up spending another night with Ryan after being fired. You're the Lor?

title: CEO's Naughty Secret
description: To take back her mother's hotel, she secretly had a baby with a CEO who was drugged and escaped before he woke up. Little did she know, her evil stepsister pretended to be her, making the CEO believe she was his one-night stand. For the sake of the hotel, she had to see him again, but she misunderstood him as being in a relationship with her stepsister, and then she found out she was pregnant.

title: Stop Calling Me Miss
description: A privileged heiress must navigate a twisted game of power, betrayal, and forbidden love when her former bodyguard, now her master, rises to claim control over her life—and her heart.

title: The Legend of Bloody Moon
description: For a long time, the wolf and the hunter have been in an endless state, and at the same time, a female master with wolf and hunting blood has been born. She has been sealed up since childhood with strong ability and can only endure in silence even if she is bullied. Her kindness and bravery have attracted the next leader of the wolf clan, the villain and the judge of the hunter clan at the same time.

title: Don't You Sleep with Me
description: Clara agrees to marry her best friend's fiancé, per her request, only to find out that he is her former crush! In order to protect her best friend's marriage, she racks her brain for all kinds of excuses to avoid intimate contact with Miles, but somehow keeps falling into a deeper trap.

title: Love Me All You Like
description: When an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, Sara finds herself pulled into Elliot’s world of luxury and privilege. As he repeatedly steps in to help her—saving her from an ex, offering her a place to stay, and supporting her during family conflicts—their connection deepens. Despite their differences, Sara and Elliot decide to marry, confronting the realities of their contrasting worlds and discovering love where they least expected it.

title: The Heiress and Her Bodyguard
description: In the hushed stillness of the night, Reginald met a tragic end in the sanctum of his study.Meanwhile, Emma, ensconced in the sterile walls of the hospital, received the heart-wrenching news of her father's demise. The very next day, Emma’s uncle, Ethan, exploiting Emma's newfound vulnerability in her blindness, demanded she relinquish her stake in the family empire.

title: My Heart Dies From Home
description: From a young age,Greta was abandoned and forced to survive on her own. In her quest to claim her adoptive father's unpaid wages, she encountered ridicule and Mistreatment at the hands of the Walker family. Unbeknownst to the Walkers, they had been tirelessly searching for a family named Clara, not realizing that Greta, the very individual they had been disparaging, was Clara all along.
